e.body:
**Contagion Mitigation in Stochastic Insurance-Reinsurance Networks**（`hirshal/insurance-network-contagion`）**是一份**硕士论文的**代码与笔记本复现包****——**逐字自述为**「**Code used in the production of my dissertation**」**，**课程逐字为**「**MSc Financial Mathematics with Data Science**」（**University of Bath**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 与文献的关系逐字写清****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写明**其**扩展**的是**「**Ruin Probabilities for Risk Processes in Stochastic Networks**」**，**并**逐字署为 **Amini 等人（2023）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**对**一份**硕士论文**来说**，**最**值得**对外**暴露的**信息**不是**「**我做了很多**」**，**而是**「**我的结果**接在**谁的**哪一步**之后**」**——**⭐ 因为**只有**这一层**信息**让**读者**能**判断**你**贡献的边界**，**也**让**后来者**知道**能不能**接着**往下做**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 没有纳入论文的部分**也**逐字标出****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**三个**纾解渠道**为**「**bail-ins, bail-outs (NOT INCLUDED IN DISSERTATION) and price floors**」**，**并**逐字说明**价格下限**是在**抛售**构成**独立传染渠道时**考察的**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**同样**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**我试过**但**没写进论文**」**与**「**我没做**」**是**两种**不同的**诚实**，**而**把**前者**标出来**，**对**读者**是**净收益**。**⭐ 而**本次**实测**仓库树**确实**同时**含 **`bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）** 与 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）****——**⭐ 即**代码**在**，**论文**不收**，**README **把**这一点**说明**了**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 结构按「**一种渠道一个模块**」拆开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**20 个文件**中**6 个 Python 模块**逐字为 **`bailin_functions.py`（31 KB）**、**`firesale_functions.py`（27 KB）**、**`bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）**、**`endogenous_functions.py`（19 KB）**、**`functions.py`（18 KB）**、**`exogenous_functions.py`（14 KB）****；**6 个 notebook** 逐字为 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailin.ipynb`（57,699 KB）**、**`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）**、**`endogenous_network_simulation.ipynb`（17,367 KB）**、**`augmented_exogenous_network_firesale.ipynb`（234 KB）**、**`exogenous_network_simulation.ipynb`（98 KB）**、**`cramer_lundberg.ipynb`（43 KB）****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一结构**对**复现**有**实际帮助**：**⭐ 即**当**一条渠道**一个文件**时**，**读者**可以**只读**自己**关心**的**那条**；**⭐ 而**`cramer_lundberg.ipynb`** 说明**作者**把**经典**破产模型**也**单列**了一节**——**⭐ 即**把**课程**里**学过的**起点**与**论文**的**扩展**放在**同一仓库**里**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库体感**：**文档稀薄、**体积几乎全是笔记本****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 仅 **680 字节**（**7 行**）**、**仓库 **65,278 KB****，**其中**6 个 notebook** 合计**约 **98 MB** 量级**（**⭐ 以**单个文件**字节数**相加**）**；**⭐ 并**实测**含 **`.DS_Store`（8 KB）** 与 **`__pycache__`** 下**6 个 **`.pyc`****（**逐字为 **cpython-312**，**即**环境**为 **Python 3.12**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**记录**这一体感**：**⭐ 即**一份**学术复现包**可以**同时**是**「**结果**可查**」**与**「**说明**很少**」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正好**是**一份**反面清单**：**⭐ 如果**你**自己**要**把**毕业论文**放上 **GitHub**，**则**把 **README **写成**「**怎么跑、**数据从哪来、**每个文件**做什么**」**只需要**半小时**，**而**它**决定**别人**会不会**真的**用**你的**工作**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[catrisk-sim]] 覆盖**巨灾组合的**随机模拟**、**[[polaris-re]] 覆盖**个险再保定价的**建模库**、**[[rcmdrplugin-riskdemo]] 覆盖**风险与**破产理论**的**教学演示**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一篇**硕士论文**级别的**网络传染**与**纾解策略**复现包**」这一形态**：**它**不**提供**产品**，**而**提供**一条**可读的**研究路径**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **写清**自己**接在**哪篇文献**之后**；**② **把**没写进论文的部分**标注出来**；**③ **一种**机制**一个文件**；**④ **README **要**写**怎么跑**，**而**不是**只写**写了什么**；**⑤ **上传前**清掉 **`.DS_Store`** 与 **`__pycache__`****。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其任何代码或笔记本**（**未安装 **Python 依赖**、**未执行**任何 **`.py`** 或 **`.ipynb`****）**，**故**不主张**其**模拟结果**、**不主张**其**复现性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**（**680 字节**）**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**任何**代码或笔记本内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**该论文**是否**已提交、**是否**通过、**以及**其**评分**或**结论**——**⚠️ 本词条**只**按**仓库自述**记录**课程与**学校**。**④ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⚠️ 学术代码**常常**没有**许可**，**但**「**论文**可用**」**不**等于**「**代码**可**再分发**」**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**仓库体积**里**有多少**是**笔记本输出**（**⭐ 只**逐文件**报告**字节数**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该仓库**是**学术复现材料**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**投资或**承保建议**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 與文獻的關係逐字寫清****——**README 逐字寫明**其擴展的是**「**Ruin Probabilities for Risk Processes in Stochastic Networks**」**，**並逐字署為**Amini 等人（2023）**；**⭐ 即**對一份碩士論文來說**，**最值得對外暴露的**不是**「**我做了很多**」**，**而是**「**我的結果接在誰的哪一步之後**」**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 沒有納入論文的部分也逐字標出****——**三個紓解渠道逐字為**「**bail-ins, bail-outs (NOT INCLUDED IN DISSERTATION) and price floors**」**，**並逐字說明**價格下限是在**拋售構成獨立傳染渠道時考察**；**⭐ 即**「**我試過但沒寫進論文**」**與**「**我沒做**」**是兩種不同的誠實**；**本次實測**倉庫樹**確實同時含** `bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）** 與 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）****。

**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫體感：文檔稀薄、**體積幾乎全是筆記本****——**README 僅 680 位元組（7 行）**、**倉庫 65,278 KB**，**6 個 notebook 合計約 98 MB 量級**；**並實測含** `.DS_Store`（8 KB）** 與 **`__pycache__`** 下 **6 個 `.pyc`****（**逐字為 cpython-312，即環境為 Python 3.12**）**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這正好是一份反面清單**——**把 README 寫成「**怎麼跑、**數據從哪來、**每個檔案做什麼**」只需半小時**，**而它決定別人會不會真的用你的工作**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[catrisk-sim]]、[[polaris-re]]、[[rcmdrplugin-riskdemo]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**一篇碩士論文級別的網絡傳染與紓解策略復現包**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **寫清接在哪篇文獻之後**；**② **標出沒寫進論文的部分**；**③ **一種機制一個檔案**；**④ **README 要寫怎麼跑**；**⑤ **上傳前清掉 `.DS_Store` 與 `__pycache__`****。

e.body_en:
This is a dissertation reproducibility package of code and notebooks on contagion mitigation in stochastic insurance and reinsurance networks, stating in writing that the code was used in the production of a dissertation submitted for a masters course in financial mathematics with data science at a British university. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface**:

**First, the relationship to the literature is stated in writing.** The description names the paper it extends, on ruin probabilities for risk processes in stochastic networks, and credits it to named authors and a year. **For a masters dissertation the most valuable thing to expose is not how much was done but which step of an existing ladder the result stands on, because that is what lets a reader judge the boundary of the contribution and lets a successor know whether the next step is available.**

**Second, the part left outside the dissertation is labelled in writing.** The three mitigation channels are listed as bail-ins, bail-outs, and price floors, with the second marked in capital letters as not included in the dissertation, and the description explains that price floors are examined when fire sales act as a separate channel of contagion. **Trying something and leaving it out of the write-up is a different kind of honesty from never doing it, and marking the former is a net gain for the reader.** **The repository tree does in fact contain both a bail-out module of twenty-four kilobytes and a bail-out notebook of nearly twenty-five megabytes, so the code exists while the dissertation excludes it, and the description says so.**

**Third, the structure is split one channel per module.** Six Python modules are present, covering bail-ins, fire sales, bail-outs, endogenous dynamics, exogenous dynamics, and shared functions, ranging from fourteen to thirty-one kilobytes, alongside six notebooks, of which the largest approaches fifty-eight megabytes and the smallest is tens of kilobytes. **When one channel is one file a reader can open only the channel they care about, and a separate notebook on the classical ruin model puts the starting point learned in coursework in the same repository as the extension.**

**Fourth, the repository is thinly documented while its size is almost entirely notebooks.** The description is a few hundred bytes over seven lines, the repository is roughly sixty-five megabytes, and the six notebooks account for the overwhelming majority of it. **Leftover system files and six compiled-python files built by a recent interpreter version are also committed, which shows the working environment but also the lack of cleanup.** **For a student preparing to publish a thesis repository, this doubles as a checklist of what to avoid: writing down how to run the code, where the data comes from, and what each file does takes half an hour and decides whether anyone actually uses the work.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover stochastic catastrophe portfolio simulation, a life reinsurance pricing library, and a teaching demonstration of risk and ruin theory, **while this entry supplies the form of a dissertation-grade reproducibility package on network contagion and mitigation, which offers not a product but a readable research path. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: state which paper your work continues; mark what was tried but left out; keep one mechanism per file; write the description so that it explains how to run the work and not only what was written; and remove system and compiled-python files before publishing.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of its code or notebooks was run**, no dependencies were installed and no file was executed, **so no claim is made about its simulation results or its reproducibility**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the contents of any code or notebook. **Third, whether the dissertation was submitted, passed, or concluded anything was not verified**, the course and institution being recorded only as the repository states them. **Fourth, the repository carries no licence file**, and for academic code the common absence of a licence means that a readable paper does not imply redistributable code. **Fifth, how much of the repository size consists of stored notebook output was not verified**, only per-file sizes being reported. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the repository is academic reproduction material rather than an insurance product or investment or underwriting advice.**
